# Stand-in plane

An Add-On package (`test_plane`, CC0) for tests: a synthetic three-wheeled
flying `WheeledVehicleData` with made-up numbers, our own triangle meshes
and a 1x1 blank texture, nothing from any Add-On. It is 8.4 across the
wings with a 1.6-wide body that collides: wider than the 1x14x10 portal's
opening, narrower than the 1x20x12's. Its `damageEmitter`s name
`StandInWreckEmitter` (not in the pack, so read as a base-game emitter)
twice; `standinsmokeemitter` is its own.
